statement.essentials: The 'lobes' of the parotid are not separate parts: surgeons name the tissue on the outer side of the nerve 'superficial' and the rest 'deep'.
statement.anatomy: Superficial and deep lobes are a surgical division defined by the plane of the facial nerve; by weight about two-thirds of the gland lies superficial to it.

numbers.label: Gland weight superficial to the nerve (ESGS levels I+II)

limitations: Small anatomical sample; the commonly quoted 80% figure is not supported by this measurement.
